name: kioko
summary: Kioko (from kioku, Japanese for memory): pluggable, self-managing long-term memory for AI agents - 15 kinds of memory, an offline or LLM-driven memory intelligence, SQLite / pgvector / Qdrant stores. Attach it to any Python agent, or run it as a REST + MCP service for any language and any MCP host. Includes a web console.
author: Kumar Nishant
